description: Establish one decided key at three replicas. Disconnect follower 3, decide two distinct additional keys on nodes 1 and 2, then reconnect 3. Observe the actual generated delta AcceptSync and compare the state returned immediately after its synchronous handler with the leader state captured before dispatch. FIFO producer queues and public APIs construct all state; messages across the declared disconnect are dropped.

harness.description: Single-thread public-API three-node driver with MemoryStorage and documented key/value snapshot semantics. Explicit try_become_leader selects leader; bounded queue drains drive generated messages. No wall-clock progress assertion is made.
semantic_changes: No target changes. Transport is a deterministic FIFO delivery driver with an explicitly declared disconnection.
Application Entry/Snapshot uses a BTreeMap for canonical serialization and overwrite merge equivalent to documented HashMap semantics.

legality.derivation: The public manual leadership API enters the real prepare protocol; every protocol message is generated by target nodes. A fully delivered common prefix is observed before disconnection. Node 3 misses only messages while disconnected. Both restored endpoints receive reconnected callbacks. Observed same-ballot Prepare/Promise precedes the targeted AcceptSync. All API calls, snapshot reads and observations occur serially with exclusive Rust ownership; no sleep or cache copy substitutes for completion. Timers are unnecessary within this finite manually driven transition and are not used to claim liveness. Each outgoing batch preserves sender-to-receiver order.
legality.applicability: Fault-free storage and Snapshot implementation matching documented key/value overwrite semantics; same-configuration transport disconnect followed by restored ordered delivery; no forged messages or direct private state injection.
alternatives: The Complete snapshot branch installs a complete state directly and is outside this delta-specific input.

grounding.derivation: The result is emitted after the exact admitted AcceptSync handler returns. The expected state is derived from a real decided leader read before dispatch, previously corroborated with node 2. Both maps are canonically serialized; ordinal, case and node independently identify the same transfer. Decided/accepted/compacted indices and phase are diagnostic output, not substituted for content equality.
